newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Gawler Craton results hurt Helix shares.
newsitem.headline: Gawler Craton results hurt Helix shares.

text.p: Shares in gold explorer Helix Resources NL hurtled lower on Friday, diving nine percent to 76 cents and bringing the Gawler Craton darling's rollercoaster ride of the last eight months nearly back to where it started.

Analysts said Thursday's second quarter activities report appeared to confirm the low grade mineralisation of the area, in South Australia. They said that while those same grades may have been enough to excite the market in mid-November with a bullion price at US$380, in the current beleaguered gold market they simply added to the negative sentiment in the sector.
Gold is now fetching $320 to $325 an ounce.
"The two real dirty words in mining at the moment are low grade given where the gold price is," said an resource analyst at a Sydney brokerage.

"That is the problem for them. They are onto a large mineralised system which is good, but the bad part is that it is low grade," he added, noting that the slide in the gold price meant all bets were off.
"Six months ago the grade would have been okay in terms of being economic but with gold prices where they are at the moment they won't have a project."

Helix shares staged a spectacular run after the release of initial drilling results in mid-November that offered the promise of a major new gold region, sparking a similar rush by myriad other resource juniors into the area.
From 45 cents on November 15, 1996, Helix shares multiplied more than 11-fold to peak just short of the A$5.00 mark at A$4.99, and then came back to earth as the bullion price dived.

Major producer Acacia Resources Ltd bought a 17.4 percent stake in Helix in February at A$4.45 per share and by mid-April had topped up its stake up to 19.9 percent, the compulsory takeover threshold.

Acacia's investment came at an average entry price of A$4.20 per share and the company said on Thursday it was assessing the future of its Helix stake, although it had not considered the issue of its value.
Helix shares ended eight cents lower at 76 cents on turnover of turnover 212,400 shares.
